description: This is a test module using pytest for testing a FastAPI application. It tests the '/user/' POST endpoint and the OpenAPI schema at '/openapi.json'. The tests utilize FastAPI's TestClient and dynamically import a module based on request parameters to create the client. The file verifies response status codes and response JSON content, including schema references and validation error structures.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a module based on request parameters to instantiate a FastAPI TestClient.

methods.name: test_post_user(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the '/user/' POST endpoint for successful user creation and checks the response JSON matches expected user info.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the '/openapi.json' endpoint to verify the OpenAPI schema matches a stored snapshot, including schema definitions and content.
